hardware.label: Phoenix lander
hardware.provenance: DOCUMENTED RECONSTRUCTION — NASA publishes no 3D model. Deck 1.5 m, solar-array span 5.52 m, robotic arm 2.35 m, top of the meteorology mast 2.2 m (NASA Phoenix press kit). Array outline many-sided (NSSDCA: "octagonal"; drawn with 10 sides, not sourced). Instrument positions SIMPLIFIED.

origin.source: HiRISE-identified lander, PSP_008591_2485 controlled orthoimage (this project, M5)
origin.registration: Lander identified by eye in the USGS controlled orthoimage PSP_008591_2485 (taken 22 hours after landing): the bright lander deck at the centre of the ~25 m dark zone scoured by its descent engines; a second dark spot with a streak ~200 m away is consistent with the heat shield (uahirise.org/PSP_008591_2485). Measured in this controlled frame; 131 m south of the catalogue coordinate (68.22 N, 234.25 E; Smith et al. 2009).

terrain.albedo: HiRISE orthoimage (RED band, single channel) at 0.5 m, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
